# Teaching, microbiology, and academic leadership

Carlos C. Goller is a Teaching Professor in the Department of Biological Sciences at North Carolina State University. His work brings together microbiology, genomics, course innovation, mentoring, and evidence-based teaching through research-rich learning experiences.

Overview

## A teaching-focused academic profile grounded in discovery and support
:::

::: {.prose}
Carlos teaches microbiology, life science, and related courses while building learning environments that help students engage deeply with science. His academic work blends classroom practice, mentoring, scholarly communication, and course innovation to support both scientific understanding and student belonging.

The site brings together research directions, publications, teaching materials, mentoring resources, and professional information in one place.
:::
